objective: Advance the Alice-native N0 semantic/judgment build from a runnable curriculum trainer into a failure-driven teaching loop without adding a separate qualification bureaucracy.
problem_signals: The N0 preflight still contained an obsolete global 300M-to-400M parameter gate even though model scale is supposed to follow observed capability and efficiency evidence.
Curriculum training reported only coarse aggregate accuracy, which was insufficient for targeted teacher repair.
The ranker path used generic tokenizer directory loading even though the native tokenizer builder guarantees tokenizer.json directly.
There was no first-class command that emitted row-level failures for the next teaching pass.
builder_actions: Converted the configured approximately 350M size into an initial reference rather than a ceiling and removed the global parameter-band failure gate.
Added structural curriculum validation for stable IDs, splits, competencies, candidate sets, preferred-index bounds, and duplicate detection.
Centralized curriculum collation, tokenizer loading, and candidate-group scoring utilities.
Added supported-set separation and separation-margin metrics so multi-valid-answer rows are evaluated without demanding numerically exact score ties.
Added per-competency development metrics to locate semantic, pragmatic, social, epistemic, ranking, or alignment weaknesses directly.
Added a deterministic evaluation stage that writes metrics, predictions, and only the failed or insufficiently separated rows for failure-driven repair.
reusable_builder_procedure: Start from a provenance-bound teacher curriculum and a native semantic checkpoint.
Evaluate by competency and by supported-set separation rather than one scalar only.
Materialize the concrete failing rows and their score margins.
Generate the next teacher batch specifically for those failure families while retaining a held-out regression set.
Change model scale only when recurring failures indicate capacity is the bottleneck rather than data, objective, or implementation.
guardrails_retained: No private Elaina identity payload is placed on the public branch.
No private identity gradient is authorized by this event.
Owner-authorized Sol teaching material remains provenance-bound rather than erased.
Canonical Elaina evidence remains the authority for Elaina-specific identity targets in N1 and later.
builder_lesson: A useful builder does not turn evaluation into a parallel bureaucracy. It converts evaluation failures directly into the next targeted teaching operation and keeps scale decisions evidence-driven.
